en.headline: Sun Dong sets June deadline for Hetao cross-border talent flow
en.dek: The technology minister said free movement of people in the innovation hub must begin by 30 June next year at the latest, following data-flow pledges.
body: Cross-boundary talent flows within the Hetao Shenzhen-Hong Kong Science and Technology Innovation Co-operation Zone will be launched by 30 June next year at the latest, Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong said.
Speaking on a radio programme on Sunday, Sun said the government hoped to launch a pilot scheme for data flows as soon as possible, while personnel movement must start by the mid-2027 deadline.

The remarks follow earlier pledges by the city’s leader to enable free movement of data by the end of 2026. Sun also discussed semiconductor production due to begin this year at the Hong Kong Microelectronics Research and Development Institute.

zh.headline: 孫東：河套跨境人才流動最遲明年6月底啟動
zh.dek: 創科局局長表示，河套合作區人員流動必須最遲於明年6月30日前展開，數據流動亦希望盡快試行。
body: 創新科技及工業局局長孫東表示，河套深港科技創新合作區的跨境人才流動，最遲須於明年6月30日前啟動。
孫東周日在電台節目中說，政府希望盡快推出數據流動試點計劃，而人員流動則必須在上述期限前展開。
有關言論是在行政長官早前承諾2026年底前實現數據自由流動之後作出。孫東亦提及香港微電子研發院今年內開始半導體生產的安排。
